title: Square root cancellation in the hyperbolic lattice counting problem over cocompact groups
summary: For cocompact Fuchsian groups $Γ\leq \hbox{PSL}(2, \mathbb{R})$ we improve Selberg's bound for the error term of the counting function in the hyperbolic lattice counting problem, achieving an essentially optimal upper bound for the error term \begin{equation*} E(X;z, w) = O(X^{1/2+\varepsilon}) \end{equation*} for almost every pair of points $z,w$. We extend this pointwise result for cocompact lattices acting on the $n$-dimensional real hyperbolic space $\mathbb{H}^n$.
